definitions.gloss: book design; bookbinding; book cover design
definitions.explanation: The overall design and physical production of a book, including the cover, binding, paper choice, and layout. In modern usage, often refers specifically to the cover and jacket design.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{装丁|そうてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This book has a beautiful design.
I picked it up because I was drawn to the cover design.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{装丁|そうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: A novel whose design was done by a famous designer has become a talking point.

notes:
USAGE:
In publishing, {装丁|そうてい} encompasses the entire physical design of a book. Book designers are called ⟦{装丁家|そうていか}→装丁家：29791_souteika⟧ and are often credited on the book's copyright page. Japanese readers often appreciate and discuss book design as an art form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装丁|そうてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (to have beautiful design)
- {装丁|そうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}がける→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧ (to design a book)
- ⟦{装丁家|そうていか}→装丁家：29791_souteika⟧ (book designer)
- {装丁|そうてい}⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ (book design)
